verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official hosted MCP server at mcp.stripe.com. Its tools cover API search, read and write, analytics and docs search. Access uses OAuth with session revocation and admin controls, restricted-key bearer auth as a fallback, and human confirmation for risky writes. A live probe confirms an OAuth-gated remote MCP endpoint that follows the MCP authorization spec. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of an authenticated end-to-end agent session making tool calls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API and search Stripe's knowledge base, including documentation and support articles.
Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
The hosted MCP server (mcp.stripe.com) exposes generic API tools plus task tools
OAuth lets you grant and revoke access without sharing an API key with the client
a live, OAuth-gated remote MCP server per the MCP authorization spec
